gen-gf-unkempt-gf-glegoo: Shaggy, shouty lettering, every stem and curve cut from one gauge of tubing. Glegoo, the text serif, has big counters and a taller lowercase, a refined editorial foil to that low, uniform bluster.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-kadwa: Unkempt gives its t a crossbar that matches the stem in weight. Heading duty goes to bluster; Kadwa, the text serif, handles the reading with open-ended curves and a larger x-height.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-piazzolla: Unkempt keeps its c visibly open so it never passes for an o. Piazzolla, the text serif, brings lowercase nearly matching its capitals, a counterweight to all that rough shouting.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-scope-one: Unkempt cuts every glyph as if from strips of equal width, stems and curves alike. Scope One, the text serif, lets its spilling counters and big x-height carry a page of reading smoothly.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-slabo-13px: Rowdy and round-rimmed, Unkempt keeps every rim as stout as its stems. Slabo 13px, a dignified serif with large open counters, stands much taller in the lowercase, and that gap is the draw.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-general-s: Friendly and inviting, Waiting for the Sunrise links its letters. General Sans meets it with smooth, unobstructed curves and a line-filling x-height, which feels comfortable for a quick, light read.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-manrope: Inviting handwriting is what Waiting for the Sunrise offers, its letters nested like links in a short chain. Handwriting charms; Manrope, the sans-serif, keeps each curve bright and quick to read.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-montserra: Waiting for the Sunrise leaves the lower curve of its g open, hand-drawn and loose. Yet Montserrat, the sans, glides under the eye through oversized counters, an easy fit for a quick look.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Bold Wallpoet rises tall in the lowercase, paper showing through between its letters. And Padyakke Expanded One, a serif with a constant-width outline and widely spread glyphs, would crowd the heading if grown large.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Commanding from the first glyph, Wallpoet climbs high in the lowercase and curves smoothly. And Stint Ultra Expanded, the text serif, floats each character apart on a pipe-cleaner line, giving the heading room.
